observations.source: User screenshot and live Linear accessibility UI at linear.app/skema/reviews
observations.finding: Split list/detail layout, For you and Created links, Add filter and Display options, Nothing to review illustration and message.
Filter menu includes Status, Author, Reviewers, GitHub team reviewers, Content, date fields, Quick to review and Missing issue.

Defaults shown: Focus grouping, Importance ordering, Closed reviews Past day, Show drafts enabled, Show GitHub team reviews enabled, Badge count All. Property controls include Repository, ID, Author, Timestamp, GitHub team, Labels, Status details, Quick to review and SLA.

limitations: Three unpacked native addon integrity mismatches; analysis used record-and-continue and treated the observed bytes as untrusted.
Main and review-preview preload semantic analyses exhausted their worker heaps.
Static package analysis did not establish renderer review behavior or observe execution.
No CDP endpoint was used for a passive runtime capture; UI observations were made separately with computer use.

implemented: Status, author, repository and content filters
PR summary renderer and GitHub link
Simulated pull-request preview with varied statuses, authors and repositories
designChoices: For you includes authored, personally requested, participated and current-user team reviews
Simplified filter form uses existing Forge controls
Focus grouping and Importance sorting are local approximations; Linear internal ranking was not recovered
notImplemented: GitHub feed ingestion and account authorization
Diffs, CI, comments, approvals and merge operations
Advanced filters, reviewer/date/label filters and badge settings
forgeImplementation.dataBoundary: Reviews accepts a typed entries prop. Routes now supply 11 explicitly labeled fictional PRs, including authored, requested, participated and team reviews. Times are relative to preview initialization; no GitHub URLs or external actions are attached.

verification.automated: 31 targeted tests passed; TypeScript, targeted ESLint, and git diff --check passed.
browser: Mobile 390x844 and desktop empty states visually checked
